0.1: Could you do me a favor and tell them to please stop? They're making life more difficult for everyone, and it's really starting to upset the townspeople. Okay? Please? \r\n#b(Yikes... Time to go.)#k\r\n

1.0: Oh, is it finally my turn? I've been watching you...

yes.0: It was smart to talk to me last, because you're looking quite ill, and I'm a doctor. Are you sure you're not sick?
